proposed_comments.title: Validate each destination before use (2/2)
proposed_comments.body:
### [P2] (2/2) Validate each destination before use

**Severity:** `medium`

The guard in (1/2) only protects the restore if it runs inside the existing per-file `try` before the target hash/copy branch. A rejected path then follows the existing catch and failure-count path, retaining the snapshot rather than silently treating restoration as successful. Apply both atomic members together. This covers a stable parent junction, not concurrent replacement between the check and copy.

```suggestion
            Ensure-DataFolderPath -RelativePath $relative
            if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $target) -and (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $target).Hash -eq (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $source).Hash)
```
